title: mentha × rotundifolia subsp. macrostachya
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. macrostachya, commonly known as Cornish mint, is a subspecies of the peppermint plant that is native to the United Kingdom. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing nausea, relieving digestive issues, and providing relief from respiratory problems such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Cornish mint are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, Cornish mint has been used in traditional herbal medicine to alleviate headaches and fever due to its cooling and analgesic effects.
